path_convention: Project-relative forward-slash paths; original filenames preserved verbatim
original_retention: All originals retained; deletion requires explicit approval
preparation_scope: Local source organization only; no question generation, knowledge extraction, runtime import or technical validation

unresolved_issues.description: Course publisher, instructor identity, source URL, publication date and original deck title were not supplied. User-provided learning reference, not an official ISC2 publication.
Copyright ownership and redistribution permission remain unconfirmed. Local preparation only; no publication or license clearance implied.
Supplied domain and lecture labels support provisional association. Alignment with the official outline and technical accuracy require later review; no new objective validation performed.
Filename timestamps establish capture order only. Timezone, original deck slide numbers, missing slides and exact transcript alignment are unknown.
Capture positions 31 (50x36) and 36 (43x22) contain no readable instructional text. Retained unchanged; intended slide/topic unresolved.
Some captures show cropped/wider/annotated versions of similar content. Retain all; do not assume unique deck slides or remove variants.
98 timestamp blocks overlap; speech recognition artifacts and repeated passages are preserved. Timestamps are not slide indices.

Potential transcription or accuracy concerns include quantitative risk notation, procedure wording, MFA factor terminology and ethical priority commentary. See Domain 1 inspection notes; no corrections made.
Domain 1 completeness is not certified; explicit non-repudiation teaching was not located in the supplied transcript. Introductory mentions are not Domain 2-5 learning materials.
